create_BaodingFixedEnvV1: create a BaodingFixedEnvV1 gym environment with a MuJoCo model path for baoding manipulation tasks
create_BaodingRandomEnvV1: create a BaodingRandomEnvV1 gym environment with randomized time period for baoding manipulation tasks
run_step: run the step method on a BaodingFixedEnvV1 environment with an action array
get_obs_dict: get the observation dictionary from a BaodingFixedEnvV1 environment sim including hand and object positions
get_reward_dict: get the reward dictionary from a BaodingFixedEnvV1 environment based on target tracking and drop detection
create_goal_trajectory: create a goal trajectory for baoding tasks with continuous or shifted target updates
reset_BaodingFixedEnvV1: reset a BaodingFixedEnvV1 environment with optional pose, velocity, and goal parameters
